title: Sargon II conquers Babylon
summary: Sargon II drives Merodach-Baladan out of Babylon and takes the throne.
description: Sargon II drives Merodach-Baladan out of Babylon and takes the throne. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 710, p. 45; Table 2, row 710, p. 41).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 710 BC (Sargon year 12).
